_comment: Hand-written measurement record for issue #1032 unit 2 (validate the day-two stage set on the emulator at scale). Deliberately NOT live/gauntlet.json: that artifact is regenerated wholesale by `gauntlet run`, which always invokes this estate's script at the default SCALE=1, so a SCALE=10/50 run recorded there would either be dropped or overwrite the scale-1 row unit 0/1 own. This file is produced by hand from `GAUNTLET stage=` lines the same way live/history/<version>.json is produced by `gauntlet snapshot`, but it is not that mechanism (that one is version-tagged full-board byte-copies, read by tools/gauntlet/notes.go's release diff) - it lives beside the script it measures instead, so nothing has to guess which estate or protocol produced it. Reproduce a row with: env SCALE=<scale> FLOCI_PORT=<port> bash live/e2e/terralith-scale/run.sh (BREAK_APPROVAL=1 added for the break row).

runs.note: negative control (#1032 unit 2's required BREAK_ proof): the script's own BREAK_APPROVAL=1 branch expects the post-approval apply to wrongly succeed (exit 0); choudoufu correctly refused it at exit 3, so that wrong expectation - and only it - failed, proving plan_approval's refusal check still fires at scale 50. Every stage up to plan_approval ran and passed exactly as the unbroken row above; plan_approval and every stage after it are fail/not_run by design, not the fix under test.

reference._comment: scale=1's canonical row is not duplicated here - it is live/gauntlet.json's own terralith-scale estate entry (last_run.stage_seconds), read at the time this file was written.

findings: run.sh's day2_count edit (render_config's count1 case) matched a literal `count = 2` and hardcoded index [1] as the instance scaled away, assuming SCALE=1; terralith-gen actually scales count_team's count as 2*SCALE (issue #574). Fixed in this commit with COUNT_FULL/COUNT_TOP - see the commit message. Found and fixed before any of the rows above were recorded, so every pass row already reflects the fix.

Not fixed, filed for a later unit: test_apply's tofu-estate-tagged-count detail (TAGGED_BEFORE/TAGGED_AFTER, around run.sh's line 895) uses `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --query 'length(ResourceTagMappingList)' --output text` against a call that paginates at 100 results. The CLI applies the query per page instead of to the merged list, so the printed detail is several page counts space-joined (e.g. '100 100 100 35' at scale 10, sixteen '100's plus '55' at scale 50) rather than one number. The sum is correct (335 and 1655, matching TAGGABLE) and the stage-pass equality check (TAGGED_BEFORE = TAGGED_AFTER) still holds since both sides page identically, so no stage's verdict is affected - this is a display defect, not a functional one, and first appears at scale 10 already (TAGGABLE=335 has has non trivial paging even then). A fix would read `ResourceTagMappingList[].ResourceARN` as one item per line and count lines instead of asking the CLI for a pre-merged length.
